NutriAgro Feeds™ Terms & Conditions

Official Agricultural Quality & Farmgate Delivery Agreement
🌾 Summary for Farmers: All feed batches are 100% aflatoxin-screened. Orders of 15+ bags qualify for free farmgate freight. Damaged bags are replaced within 48 hours.

1. 100% Aflatoxin Clearance & Lab Quality

Every batch undergoes ELISA screening to ensure total aflatoxin levels remain strictly under 20 ppb. Moisture is maintained below 12% to prevent mold growth during farm storage. Tamper-evident bags are heat-sealed at the central mill.

2. Free Farmgate Freight & Delivery Guidelines

Orders of 15 bags (750 kg) or more receive 100% Free Farmgate Freight Delivery. Customer must ensure an accessible road for delivery trucks (minimum 10-foot width) and arrange farm labor to assist unloading into dry storage.

3. 7-Day Gradual Herd Transition Protocol

To protect rumen digestion, transition livestock gradually over 7 days (25% new feed on Days 1-2, 50% on Days 3-4, 75% on Days 5-6, 100% on Day 7). Provide continuous fresh drinking water.

4. Bag Damage & 48-Hour Replacement Guarantee

If any bag arrives torn or wet due to transit weather, report it with a photo to our toll-free hotline (1800-890-4567) within 48 hours for immediate replacement.

5. Payment on Delivery & GST Invoices

Payment accepted via Cash on Delivery (COD), UPI (PhonePe / GPay), or site cheque upon physical bag arrival. Commercial entities receive official tax invoices.
